what: Tacit checkpoints, one forward per decision (Tacit(adaptive=False)): the options in the order the benchmark lists them, the answer read as the argmax of the softmax over the option labels. Accuracy on every item of both test sets.

bev_decision_test.source: https://huggingface.co/datasets/avbiswas/bev-decision, default config, test split, every (state, question) pair

note: Measured by the maintainers' evaluation harness, which is released together with the adaptive (one forward + reasoning) results. Before upload, every exported checkpoint was reloaded and gave the same answers as the evaluated weights on 256 bev-decision test pairs. Run through Tacit from the Hub, one forward agreed with these evaluations on 96.6-100% of 1,000 bev-decision and 213 JevBench items, with accuracy within 0.6 points on bev-decision.
